ambiguities: The source thickens the top and left edges of the closed packet to indicate layered open edges. These are rendered as distinct1pt native layer outlines with tiny rigid display offsets; bottom/right remain the fold edges.
Reverse-side bands are retained as semantic material-side coding, not decorative lighting. All bands are native coplanar geometry and do not introduce mathematical lines.
Tiny layer-disclosure translations do not alter the square paper, exact creases or cut construction; the answer audit uses the coincident closed stack.

models.first_fold: horizontal, closed into two two-layer packets
models.second_fold: vertical right-edge hinge, shown30degrees from closed
models.layer_disclosure: Each packet has two rigid square layers separated by a tiny3D translation solely to disclose the source stack. Mathematical fold/cut audit uses zero-gap closed quarters.
models.material_side_code: front solid gray, reverse alternating light bands
